description: This PHP class defines a collection for managing scaffold files within a Drupal project, including construction, filtering, processing, and iteration over scaffold file info objects.

classes.name: ScaffoldFileCollection
classes.description: A collection class managing multiple scaffold files, supporting construction, filtering, iteration, and processing of scaffold file info objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the collection with file mappings and location replacements, building a nested array of scaffold files grouped by project.

methods.name: filterFiles
methods.description: Removes files from the collection based on a list of destination paths.

methods.name: checkListHasItemWithContent
methods.description: Checks if any scaffold file in a list has non-empty contents.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the scaffold files grouped by project.

methods.name: processScaffoldFiles
methods.description: Processes all scaffold files, outputting results and writing to the IO interface.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Static method to process a collection of scaffold files, deprecated in newer versions.

methods.name: checkUnchanged
methods.description: Returns a list of files that have not changed since being scaffolded.
